descriptionChirho: A feminine noun (רִצְפָּה) denoting a paved stone surface or pavement, whether a courtyard floor, temple pavement, or processional surface. The two clusters differ only in grammatical state — absolute ('the pavement') vs. construct ('pavement of') — not in meaning: eng the-pavement/pavement-of, spa el-pavimento/pavimento-de, hin फर्श/फ़र्श, arb الرَّصِيفِ/רַصִּיפִי, kor 포장/바닥에, swa sakafu/juu-ya. All 7 occurrences refer to the same physical concept of a stone-paved surface.
